question.asked: Do exposure duration and fibroblast IL-1 reception separately determine mature epithelial recovery after verified withdrawal?
what_is_not_being_asked: whether a transitional RNA score declines after withdrawal
whether receptor or inhibitor RNA predicts an inflammatory RNA response (that is A12)
whether a fibroblast programme adds information in human cross-sections (that is A13)

H1_duration.statement: longer IL-1beta exposure reduces mature epithelial recovery after verified withdrawal, relative to transient exposure at matched intensity
H1_duration.population: alveolar epithelial cells in a system where exposure can be started and stopped and the same preparation followed afterwards
H1_duration.primary_outcome: mature-cell yield per unit after a fixed post-withdrawal interval
safeguards: traced descendants where a lineage label exists
rivals: time in culture or in vivo rather than time under exposure
H1_duration.decision: a meaningful decrease after sustained versus transient exposure supports H1 under the prespecified uncertainty rule; a reliable meaningful increase contradicts its direction; otherwise a precise absence of a meaningful decrement weakens it; an imprecise estimate, failed engagement or missing post-withdrawal observation is inconclusive

decision_specification.contrast: recovery after sustained exposure minus recovery after transient exposure
decision_specification.status: threshold and uncertainty rule must be fixed before outcome inspection; this contract does not yet authorize scoring
decision_specification.interpretation_limits: viability must distinguish reduced recovery from toxicity; absent lineage evidence limits inference to mature yield rather than recovery of originally transitional cells

H2_reception.statement: fibroblast IL-1 reception modifies epithelial recovery beyond direct epithelial reception of the same signal
H2_reception.population: a system containing both compartments in which IL1R1 can be removed from one compartment at a time under fixed exposure
H2_reception.primary_outcome: mature-cell yield per unit, defined identically to H1
H2_reception.decision: an outcome change under fibroblast-specific intervention with epithelial reception controlled supports H2; a precise absence weakens it; failed engagement is inconclusive

joint_design_eligibility.H1: identifiable duration contrast at fixed receiving conditions, with time-matched unexposed controls
joint_design_eligibility.H2: identifiable reception contrast at fixed exposure and withdrawal schedule, with direct epithelial reception controlled
joint_design_eligibility.requirements: each hypothesis must meet its own observation, engagement, outcome and biological-unit requirements; assess interactions and uncertainty without treating shared units as independent replication
joint_design_eligibility.prohibited: inferring separate duration and reception effects from an inseparable contrast that changes both factors together

unit_and_inference.unit: the animal, or an independently prepared culture
unit_and_inference.floor: at least three independent units per arm with identities recorded; this floor alone does not establish adequate decision precision
unit_and_inference.repeat_wells_are_not_preparations: four wells split from a common mixture count as one unit (A2 recovered methods)

motivating_but_non_answering_evidence.A12: exploratory 12-patient pilot: recipient receptor and inhibitor RNA improved held-out prediction of an inflammatory RNA response; fibroblast increment unstable; no withdrawal, no reception measurement
motivating_but_non_answering_evidence.A13: amended pilot: no aggregate held-out gain from a fibroblast programme; RMSE 0.2283 to 0.2373; human cross-section

feasibility_state_on_2026_09_29.outcome_requirement: RQ_Specified/A1_transitional_epithelial_state_distinction/reports/A1_A8_A14_OUTCOME_INVENTORY.md row O28; eligible withdrawal evidence remains unidentified
feasibility_state_on_2026_09_29.available_measurement_boundary: O2/O3 contain measured mature and genetically lineage-labelled endpoints, but do not establish A14's required linkage and contrasts; O29's EdU/BrdU/label-retention documentation limit does not negate genetic lineage evidence
feasibility_state_on_2026_09_29.note: the survey covered A1 documents; no public-archive search under these eligibility conditions has been completed, and no global absence or infeasibility is established

eligible_routes: existing deposits with sufficient supporting metadata
available author-provided data meeting the same contract
new data generation if bounded sourcing remains unresolved
evidence_sourcing.bounded_search_status: not performed; record source scope, queries and stopping rule before sourcing
evidence_sourcing.candidate_record: record acceptance, rejection or unresolved eligibility and reasons separately for H1 and H2
evidence_sourcing.requirements_unchanged: endpoint, withdrawal, timing, contrast, safeguards and independent biological units apply to every route

prohibitions: reading loss of a transitional RNA score as recovery
inferring separate effects from confounded inseparable duration and reception contrasts
claiming withdrawal without measured post-withdrawal engagement
treating receptor or inhibitor RNA as measured reception
counting repeat wells from one mixture as independent preparations
presenting an anticipated response curve as a result
extending either result to malignant transformation
